records.text: George Griggs told Catherine Pollard Griggs that military officials knew the Beirut Marine barracks bombing was coming before it occurred.
records.speaker: Katharine Pollard Griggs

appearances.snippet: and in fact he told you that they knew the bombing was coming down in Beirut before it occurred.

verification.notes: The archived full interview transcript directly records Catherine Pollard Griggs saying that George Griggs told her military officials had warnings and knew the Beirut barracks bombing was coming. This verifies the attributed statement, not the underlying allegation.

sources.title: Kay Griggs Full Transcript, Parts 1–4
sources.relevance: Primary interview transcript records Griggs attributing advance knowledge of the Beirut bombing to what George Griggs told her.
